description: Held-out candidate assessment items for the MC-BASE-SMALLEST misconception. Each is labelled with whether a careful instructor would accept it as a check that distinguishes the misconception. Includes realistic traps (a 'misconception' implementation that is actually correct, a misconception that fails for the wrong reason). Written after the validator was fixed.

cases.note: list_length: one-element base recurses forever on []
trap: the 'misconception' version is actually correct for sum_digits
reference solution is off by one
no test probes the smallest input
misconception version fails with TypeError, not by missing the base case, so the item does not isolate the concept
